purpose: An explicit owner-selected delivery or no-delivery outcome bound to one accepted campaign candidate.

owner_approval.rule: Approval scope must equal the choice scope digest; approval is not a credential or activation.
owner_approval.reference_rule: approval_ref is an opaque reference and must not contain a name, path, host identity, session identity, or secret.

binding_rules: Every non-PREPARED outcome requires accepted_result_digest and final_audit_digest.
DEPLOY, RELEASE, and ROLLBACK require an opaque environment_ref.
ROLLBACK requires rollback_target_digest naming the exact prior delivery receipt.
The source commit and tree are immutable for the choice.
A choice never authorizes a protected action by itself.
